## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint issues — Issues, comments, relations, history and execution links.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint issues COMMAND [ARGS] [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Choose a subcommand, then inspect its exact --help before execution.

SUBCOMMANDS
  activity            GitHub App connection or explicit mapping through authenticated HTTP; current project authority is rechecked.
  archive             Issue UUID, current key or prior alias; writes require current revision; history is authorized and paginated
  attachments         Browse subcommands.
  branch              Create or check out work/KEY-title in the matching connected repository; preserve uncommitted changes.
  comments            Browse subcommands.
  create              create server record
  delete              delete server record
  estimate            Set an estimate including zero; JSON null clears it.
  get                 Read permitted records
  history             Issue UUID, current key or prior alias; writes require current revision; history is authorized and paginated
  links               GitHub App connection or explicit mapping through authenticated HTTP; current project authority is rechecked.
  list                Read permitted records
  move-team           Issue UUID, current key or prior alias; writes require current revision; history is authorized and paginated
  relations           Browse subcommands.
  restore             Issue UUID, current key or prior alias; writes require current revision; history is authorized and paginated
  states              Read authorized native metadata snapshot only
  update              update server record

EXAMPLES
  sprint issues get --help

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

SEE ALSO
  sprint help
  sprint topic output
  Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs/blob/main/cli/reference/issues.md
```
